name: expanded_SR_two_bin_exploratory_2017_v1
rationale: Retain the finest contiguous coarsening supported by AN-reference development background MC at n_eff >= 1/0.175^2. Preserve the original four-bin study and its failures.
selection_basis: AN-reference development background yields and variances only; signal scores and candidate rankings do not choose the boundaries. Both existing folds were inspected before this follow-up.
qcd_group_interpretation: Recompute sumw and sumw2 in each coarse bin and give each its own linear Gaussian MC direction. The reference stage adds the 15% blanket term in quadrature in that same direction. The independent blanket terms are a modeling assumption; shared process normalization and template nuisances remain correlated. This is a new coarse likelihood, not a covariance-preserving projection of the original groups.
